title: From Rural Ethiopia to Addis Ababa
style_prompt: warm hand-painted storybook illustration, soft film grain, golden-hour light, earthy greens and terracotta, gentle humor, no text in the image
character_prompt: adult Ethiopian man from rural Ethiopia, with short tightly curled black hair, a neatly trimmed short beard and mustache, dark rectangular glasses, and a plain black T-shirt. Natural adult facial proportions and a warm, relaxed expression.

character_reference.prompt: A waist-up character turnaround with front, three-quarter and profile views of the same adult. Grounded Ethiopian storybook portraiture, hand-painted gouache, softly modeled natural features, warm brown skin with natural tonal variation, and a muted ochre backdrop inspired by the rural Ethiopian highlands. Keep the glasses, black T-shirt and facial features consistent across all three views. No labels.
character_reference.continuity_prompt: Use image 0 as the character and illustration reference. Keep the character's recognizable features and clothing where he appears. Compose the main subject centrally for both vertical and horizontal crops.

narration_style: Read warmly and playfully, like a friend telling a story. Light comic timing on the jokes, slower and softer on the last two lines.

music.caption: warm acoustic instrumental, light Ethiopian-pentatonic feel, gentle percussion, hopeful and playful, no strong lead melody

shots.image_prompt: One wide establishing landscape of the green highlands of rural Ethiopia at sunrise. A small rural house and grassy ridges are the subjects. A thin gold loading ring hangs in the sky like a sun. The entire landscape is empty of people, faces, and figures. One uninterrupted composition.
shots.narration: I was born in the rural countryside of Ethiopia, where the mornings are green and the internet is a rumour.

shots.image_prompt: The character as a boy at a window with a borrowed laptop, curious
shots.narration: I learned to code on a borrowed laptop, one tiny download at a time.

shots.image_prompt: A single continuous scene of one programmer, alone at a wooden desk, smiling at the first program on his borrowed laptop. The camera is just behind his shoulder, with the glowing laptop screen and keyboard filling most of the center. Show one programmer and one laptop, with no duplicate people, portraits, or panels.
shots.narration: My first program said Hello World. The page took an hour to load. Worth it.

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of two pairs of hands passing a packed cloth bag across a wooden table in a warm rural Ethiopian home. The bag and hands fill the center. Frame only from wrist level down. Every head, face, and torso is entirely outside the frame.
shots.narration: My mother packed one bag and said, 'Go. Call me when you arrive.'
shots.music_cue: Soft and curious, with a lift at the goodbye

shots.image_prompt: Crowded bus on a winding road, laptop on his knees, bags piled on the roof, loading circle on the window
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan along the road, gentle sway
shots.narration: The bus to Addis took all day. My laptop rode on my knees. My dreams rode on the roof.

shots.image_prompt: Addis Ababa traffic and tall buildings, the character tiny and wide-eyed, loading circle floating over the jam
shots.narration: Addis was loud, fast, and full of better developers. I got lost twice. Once on the map.

shots.image_prompt: One scene of a single developer working alone at a desk late at night, seated in three-quarter view. Warm desk lamp, many coffee cups and cool screen glow. Center the developer in one uninterrupted composition, with no duplicates or panels.
shots.narration: So I coded at night, broke things in the morning, and fixed them by lunch. Repeat.

shots.image_prompt: One centered portrait of a single confident developer holding a phone with a blank screen toward the viewer. Warm daylight and a calm, simple background. One person, one continuous frame.
shots.narration: Years later, I founded and built EatSmart. It even helped me lose weight.

shots.image_prompt: A single continuous portrait of one man, alone, gently smiling as he holds a phone to his ear. Center him in a quiet Addis Ababa room at golden hour. One character, one frame. The person on the other end of the call is entirely offscreen.
shots.narration: Then I finally called her. 'Mother, I arrived.' If a boy from rural Ethiopia can, so can you.

shots.image_prompt: One continuous close-up of one developer grinning as he looks down at a laptop. The laptop screen shows a small circular buffering ring. Place the face and laptop near the center of the same scene, with no duplicate figures or panels.
shots.narration: Now, if you'll excuse me, my page is still loading.
